summary: Authentic full-backbuffer D3D9 ColorFill after color-only native Draw retires the previous native scene and seeds a fresh contiguous same-Present Draw epoch. Later depth-dependent draws, missing original Draw coverage, poisoned batches and unowned ColorFill fall back to D3D9. Real game/HMD output untested.

Full frame publication consumes exact new epoch ordinals while old Draws remain retired; depth-dependent calls reject.
Invalid, clipped, depth/stencil, foreign and poisoned source continues original D3D9 Draw/Present/input/FFB.
Five required GitHub Actions succeed at one result SHA.
